scope.summary: Implement notes covering footnotes, endnotes, and sidenotes. Footnote options: numbering (style, start, restart per page/spread/section, prefix/suffix, character/paragraph styles, separator) and layout (spacing, rule above, placement, span across columns). Endnote options: title, numbering style and restart scope, story-vs-document scope, endnote-frame placement, and styles. Sidenotes anchor to the last text line or a frame edge, inside or outside the margin, with per-scope restart. Notes are part of the StudioTextStory composition; restart scopes interact with numbering (MT-150).
acceptance_criteria: footnotes + endnotes + sidenotes with full numbering/restart/layout/placement options
proof_targets: footnote numbering/restart runtime; endnote-scope + sidenote-anchor test
expected_tests: live: footnotes number+restart per page/spread/section with rule-above + span-columns placement
test: endnotes story/document scope + endnote-frame placement; sidenotes anchor last-line/frame-edge inside/outside margin

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Footnotes, endnotes & sidenotes

risk_if_missed: No scholarly/technical notes; academic and reference publishing impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
